title: Common Schema Definitions
description: Shared schema definitions for workflow v2

baseFailedResult.description: Base failed result structure (can be extended with additional properties)

credential_id.description: Nexus credential UUID for authentication. When provided, the credential is resolved at execution time and injected into the node config.

retry_policy.description: Retry configuration for failed node execution. Only applies to executor and approval nodes. Unset fields inherit from global settings. Set max_retries to 0 to explicitly disable retry.

max_retries.description: Number of retries after the initial attempt. 0 = no retry. Inherits from global settings when absent.

initial_interval.description: Initial retry interval in seconds. Inherits from global settings when absent.

max_interval.description: Maximum retry interval in seconds. Inherits from global settings when absent.

backoff_coefficient.description: Multiplier applied to the interval after each retry. 1.0 = fixed interval (no growth). Values above 1.0 give exponential backoff. Inherits from global settings when absent.

nodeSettings.description: Engine-level settings that control how the workflow engine runs a node.

continue_on_failure.description: When true, downstream nodes continue executing even if this node fails. Inherits from global settings when absent.

executorSettings.description: Engine-level settings for executor nodes (script, http_request, agentic, AAP job/workflow template).

timeout.description: Activity execution timeout in seconds. Falls back to the global timeout setting if not specified.
